server_host.description: Hostname or IP address of the IRC server to connect to.

server_port.description: Port number for the IRC server connection. Ignored if unix_socket is set.

unix_socket.description: Path to a Unix domain socket. If set, connection is made via this socket instead of TCP.

irc_dir.description: Base directory where ii creates the tree of FIFO and output files.

nickname.description: Nickname to use on the IRC network. Defaults to $USER if not specified.

real_name.description: Real name (display name) associated with the nickname.

channels.description: List of channel names to join. Each item is a string containing the channel name (e.g., '#linux').

use_ssl_tunnel.description: Boolean flag to indicate whether to connect via a local SSL tunnel (e.g., stunnel/socat) instead of a direct connection.

ssl_tunnel_socket.description: Path to the local Unix socket created by the SSL tunnel tool (e.g., stunnel) when use_ssl_tunnel is true.
